fact: INSTAD officially launched the third national statistics development strategy (SNDS-3) for 2025-2029 on Monday 24 February 2025, and the text says the recent evaluation of the 2011 and 2018 strategies showed significant progress despite COVID-19.
title: L’INSTAD lance la 3ème Stratégie Nationale de Développement de la Statistique 2025-2029
